name: Smoked Pork with Axone
instructions: 1. Cut the smoked pork into bite-sized pieces and boil in water until tender.
2. In a mortar, crush the garlic, ginger, and King Chilli into a coarse paste.
3. Add the Axone (fermented soybean) to the boiling pork.
4. Stir in the ginger-garlic-chilli paste and salt.
5. Simmer on low heat until the liquid reduces to a thick, flavorful gravy and the pork is perfectly tender.
6. Serve hot with steamed white rice.
description: Smoked Pork with Axone is a signature delicacy of the Naga tribes. It embodies the essence of Naga cuisine, relying on preservation techniques like smoking meat and fermenting soybeans to produce a distinctive, strong umami flavor that is central to their culinary heritage.
